cases.prompt: CSV schema documentation Skill을 새로 만들어줘.
assertions: Routes Skill-specific decisions through the Skill reference
Prefers a minimal SKILL.md package and adds resources only when needed
Keeps target-specific rules out of portable guidance

cases.prompt: 이 기존 SKILL.md의 중복과 과도한 절차를 줄이고 직접 수정해줘.
assertions: Treats mols-agent-asset as the primary capability for general Skill improvement
Prefers the established Skill owner over creating a competing Skill
Preserves essential responsibility and valid behavior
Does not normalize unrelated structure or create ceremonial maintainer docs

cases.prompt: 최근 단순화에서 핵심 동작이 빠진 것 같아. 기존 근거를 보고 복구해줘.
assertions: Uses current source, project authority, and established intent as evidence
Separates durable behavior from incidental wording or layout
Restores the smallest coherent behavior without inventing a new owner

cases.prompt: 이 Skill을 현재 프로젝트의 Rulesync source와 실제 target runtime에 맞게 조정해줘.
assertions: Keeps the source framework as authority for canonical representation
Consults current target authority only for target-specific semantics
Does not edit a generated target projection as canonical source

cases.prompt: 같은 scope에 같은 규칙 문장이 두 번 들어갔어. 중복을 제거해줘.
assertions: Uses the Rule reference
Removes a confirmed equivalent peer duplicate when application and authority are the same
Does not add an abstraction layer merely to deduplicate text

cases.prompt: 루트 규칙과 하위 디렉터리 규칙이 비슷해. DRY하게 합쳐줘.
assertions: Resolves intended application before moving or deleting guidance
Preserves narrower exceptions or required scope-specific copies
Checks precedence or attachment differences instead of assuming textual duplication

cases.prompt: Rulesync가 생성한 target 규칙 파일에도 같은 문장이 있어. 거기서 하나 지워줘.
assertions: Treats generated or projected copies as derived rather than independent authority
Does not hand-edit the derived copy merely for physical DRY
Routes the change to the canonical editable source when authorized

cases.prompt: 이 subagent 정의의 책임이 너무 넓어. 기존 역할을 보존하면서 좁혀줘.
assertions: Uses the common authoring contract without inventing an agent-specific reference
Preserves source and project authority
Makes the smallest coherent responsibility change
Does not claim Skill installation as mols-agent-asset responsibility
Routes installation to a dedicated installation capability when available

cases.prompt: 이 agent asset을 readiness 기준으로 심층 검증하고 adversarial eval까지 해줘.
assertions: Treats mols-agent-asset-validator as the primary capability
Does not expand the authoring Skill into a formal validation framework

cases.prompt: adversarial eval에서 trigger false positive가 확인됐어. 그 finding 근거로 이 Skill을 수정하고 다시 검증해줘.
assertions: Keeps mols-agent-asset-validator primary because the requested correction is driven by validation evidence and includes re-validation
May compose authoring guidance only where its responsibility independently applies
Does not turn general authoring into a second validation owner

cases.prompt: VS Code에서 쓸 재사용 prompt 파일 하나 만들어줘.
assertions: Does not claim prompt authoring as a maintained mols-agent-asset type
Does not add a prompt-specific reference or workflow to mols-agent-asset

cases.prompt: 에이전트 작업 전에 실행되는 hook 설정을 만들어줘.
assertions: Does not claim Hook authoring as a maintained mols-agent-asset type
Does not add a Hook-specific reference or workflow to mols-agent-asset
Does not claim MCP authoring as a maintained mols-agent-asset type
Does not add an MCP-specific reference or workflow to mols-agent-asset

cases.prompt: README 문장을 더 읽기 좋게 다듬어줘.
assertions: Does not activate agent-asset authoring for ordinary human-facing prose
